title: Design: Every row ticked on the Inactive tab looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two inactive parts, part A and part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 4.6 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Activate parts.
  4. Click the checkbox in the header row.
  5. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Cycle count, Activate parts and Export.

Step 3:

  • The dark bar appears with a small blue "Activate" button, the same blue as Deactivate on the Active tab.

Step 4:

  • The header box shows a white tick on dark grey: every listed row is ticked.
  • Both rows are shaded light grey with ticked boxes.
  • The bar reads 2 selected and "2 records selected." shows under the table.

Step 5:

  • The dark bar and the checkboxes disappear; parts A and B are still listed on the Inactive tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S3-R1: “Reactivation uses the same mode as Story 2. On the Inactive tab the actions menu entry reads "Activate parts", and turning it on shows the same checkbox column and the same bulk bar.”
  • S3-R2: “The bulk bar button reads "Activate", in the same blue as "Deactivate".”
  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”

From: Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026, written against PRD v22; re-shared by the QA lead on 27 Oct 2026, unchanged), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, §3 Technical Decisions, D24: “Show "N records selected." under the table in bulk mode (boards 4.3, 4.9).”
